about: An answer of the Foundry project's Responses API when a content filter or Prompt Shields stops a request: HTTP 400 with the code content_filter. It is written by hand in the shape Azure OpenAI documents, because the gate's machine has no key. Replace it with a recorded answer when ops/agent/shields_live.py first runs (docs/workspace-catchup.md).

error.message: The response was filtered due to the prompt triggering Azure OpenAI's content management policy.
